description: Airworthy Bf 108 B Taifun built at Regensburg in 1940, Werknummer 2246; acquired by the Deutsche Lufthansa Berlin-Stiftung in 1990, restored over several years and operated by the Quax-Verein since July 2019. Displayed in the Quax-Hangar when not flying.
Airworthy Jungmann built in Spain in 1951 as a CASA 1.131 with a Tigre G-IVA engine. Shown in the Quax-Hangar between flights.
Airworthy Bölkow 208 Junior donated to the Quax-Verein and flown by members since 2014; displayed in the Quax-Hangar between flights.
aliases: Bo208; Bo 208; Bolkow Junior; MFI-9; MFI9

description: Airworthy Klemm Kl 35 D that served the Swedish Air Force as Fv 5050, later SE-BGD and N505Q in the United States before returning to Germany with the Quax-Verein. Displayed in the Quax-Hangar between flights.

Airworthy Do 27, Werknummer 429, delivered 12 November 1959 to 3. Luftrettungs- und Verbindungsstaffel at Faßberg as LC+155 and later flown by LTG 62 at Ahlhorn; painted in its 1959 delivery scheme. Displayed in the Quax-Hangar between flights.
The last airworthy German licence-built Fouga CM.170 Magister, based at Paderborn and shown in the Quax-Hangar between flights.
Fieseler Fi 156 Storch listed among the aircraft shown in the Quax-Hangar; registration not established from the sources consulted and the aircraft may be absent when flying.
Piper J-3C Cub shown in the Quax-Hangar; the Quax fleet includes D-EKKA but the individual aircraft on show rotates, so the registration is left blank.
aliases: J3C; J-3 Cub; Piper Cub; C65Cub; J3

description: Piper PA-18 Super Cub shown in the Quax-Hangar; several Super Cubs are operated in the Quax circle so the individual registration on display is not fixed.
Klemm Kl 107 light aircraft listed among the Quax-Hangar exhibits; registration not established from the sources consulted.
